acceptanceCriteria: A Read/Edit of a path outside the project root yields an exclusion, not an ADAPTER-DEGRADATION.
An in-project absolute path is relativized and accepted.
An unresolvable in-project path is still a degradation.
Spec/requirement updated in the same change.
body: Post-tool events for tool calls on absolute paths outside the project (scratchpad, /private/tmp lane clones, other repos) are reported as degradations. A path outside the project root is out of scope, not a degradation: classify it as an explicit exclusion (counted, not degraded), and keep a degradation only for in-project paths that cannot be relativized. Evidence: `corvint observations` in ~/projects/corvint on 2026-10-19 (Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 668, Claude Code plugin corvint@corvint 0.3.1).
